articles.title_en: Multi-dimensional latent group structures with heterogeneous distributions
articles.title_cn: 具有异质性分布的多维潜在分组结构
articles.abstract_en: This paper aims to identify the multi-dimensional latent grouped heterogeneity of distributional effects. We consider a panel quantile regression model with additive cross-section and time fixed effects. The cross-section effects and quantile slope coefficients are both characterized by grouped patterns of heterogeneity, but each unit can belong to different groups for cross-section effects and slopes. We propose a composite-quantile approach to jointly estimate multi-dimensional group memberships, slope coefficients, and fixed effects. We show that using multiple quantiles improves clustering accuracy if memberships are quantile-invariant. We apply the methods to examine the relationship between managerial incentives and risk-taking behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文旨在识别分布效应的多维潜在分组异质性。我们考虑一个带有可加截面和时间固定效应的面板分位数回归模型。截面效应和分位数斜率系数均以分组异质性模式为特征，但每个单元在截面效应和斜率上可以属于不同的组。我们提出了一种复合分位数方法，用于联合估计多维组成员身份、斜率系数和固定效应。我们表明，如果成员身份是分位数不变的，使用多个分位数可以提高聚类准确性。我们将这些方法应用于检验管理层激励与风险承担行为之间的关系。

articles.title_en: Canonical correlation-based model selection for the multilevel factors
articles.title_cn: 基于典型相关的多层次因子模型选择
articles.abstract_en: We develop a novel approach based on the canonical correlation analysis to identify the number of the global factors in the multilevel factor model. We propose the two consistent selection criteria, the canonical correlations difference (CCD) and the modified canonical correlations (MCC). Via Monte Carlo simulations, we show that CCD and MCC select the number of global factors correctly even in small samples, and they are robust to the presence of serially correlated and weakly cross-sectionally correlated idiosyncratic errors as well as the correlated local factors. Finally, we demonstrate the utility of our approach with an application to the multilevel asset pricing model for the stock return data in 12 industries in the U.S.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种基于典型相关分析的新方法，用于识别多层次因子模型中全局因子的数量。我们提出了两个一致的选取准则，即典型相关差异（CCD）和修正典型相关（MCC）。通过蒙特卡洛模拟，我们表明即使在样本较小的情况下，CCD和MCC也能正确选择全局因子的数量，并且它们对序列相关和弱横截面相关的特质误差以及相关的局部因子的存在具有稳健性。最后，我们通过将我们的方法应用于美国12个行业的股票收益数据的多层次资产定价模型，展示了其效用。

articles.title_en: Estimation of panel group structure models with structural breaks in group memberships and coefficients
articles.title_cn: 具有组成员关系和系数结构突变的面板分组结构模型的估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper considers linear panel data models with a grouped pattern of heterogeneity when the latent group membership structure and/or the values of slope coefficients change at a break point. We propose a least squares approach to jointly estimate the break point, group membership structure, and coefficients. The proposed estimators are consistent, and the asymptotic distribution of the coefficient estimators is identical to that under known break point and group structure even when the cross-sectional sample size is much larger than the length of time series. Monte Carlo simulations and an empirical example illustrate the use of the approach and associated inference.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了当潜在组成员结构和/或斜率系数值在断点处发生变化时，具有分组异质性模式的线性面板数据模型。我们提出了一种最小二乘方法，用于联合估计断点、组成员结构和系数。所提出的估计量是一致的，并且即使当横截面样本量远大于时间序列长度时，系数估计量的渐近分布也与已知断点和组结构下的渐近分布相同。蒙特卡洛模拟和一个实证例子说明了该方法及相关推断的使用。

articles.title_en: Shrinkage estimation of network spillovers with factor structured errors
articles.title_cn: 因子结构误差下网络溢出效应的收缩估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the estimation of a panel data model with cross-sectional interaction that is flexible both in its approach to specifying the network of connections between cross-sectional units, and in controlling for unobserved heterogeneity. It is assumed that there are different sources of information available on a network, which can be represented in the form of multiple weights matrices. These matrices may reflect observed links, different measures of connectivity, groupings or other network structures, and the number of matrices may be increasing with sample size. A penalised quasi-maximum likelihood estimator is proposed which aims to alleviate the risk of network misspecification by shrinking the coefficients of irrelevant weights matrices to exactly zero. Moreover, controlling for unobserved factors in estimation provides a safeguard against the misspecification that might arise from unobserved heterogeneity. The asymptotic properties of the estimator are derived in a framework where the true value of each parameter remains fixed as the total number of parameters increases. A Monte Carlo simulation is used to assess finite sample performance, and in an empirical application the method is applied to study the prevalence of network spillovers in determining growth rates across countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了具有横截面交互作用的面板数据模型的估计，该模型在设定横截面单元之间的网络连接方式以及控制未观测异质性方面均具有灵活性。假设存在关于网络的不同信息来源，这些信息可以以多个权重矩阵的形式表示。这些矩阵可能反映观测到的联系、不同的连通性度量、分组或其他网络结构，且矩阵的数量可能随样本量增加而增加。本文提出了一种惩罚拟极大似然估计器，旨在通过将无关权重矩阵的系数收缩至精确为零来减轻网络误设的风险。此外，在估计中控制未观测因子为可能由未观测异质性引起的误设提供了保障。在总参数数量增加而每个参数真实值保持固定的框架下，推导了该估计量的渐近性质。通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估有限样本性能，并在一个实证应用中，将该方法用于研究网络溢出效应在决定各国增长率中的普遍性。

articles.title_en: A test for Kronecker Product Structure covariance matrix
articles.title_cn: 克罗内克积结构协方差矩阵的检验
articles.abstract_en: We propose a test for a covariance matrix to have Kronecker Product Structure (KPS). KPS implies a reduced rank restriction on a certain transformation of the covariance matrix and the new procedure is an adaptation of the Kleibergen and Paap (2006) reduced rank test. To derive the limiting distribution of the Wald type test statistic proves challenging partly because of the singularity of the covariance matrix estimator that appears in the weighting matrix. We show that the test statistic has a χ2 limiting null distribution with degrees of freedom equal to the number of restrictions tested. Local asymptotic power results are derived. Monte Carlo simulations reveal good size and power properties of the test. Re-examining fifteen highly cited papers conducting instrumental variable regressions, we find that KPS is not rejected in 56 out of 118 specifications at the 5% nominal size.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种检验协方差矩阵是否具有克罗内克积结构（KPS）的方法。KPS意味着协方差矩阵的某种变换存在降秩限制，新程序是对Kleibergen和Paap（2006）降秩检验的改编。推导Wald型检验统计量的极限分布具有挑战性，部分原因是权重矩阵中出现的协方差矩阵估计量的奇异性。我们证明该检验统计量具有χ2极限零分布，自由度等于所检验的限制数量。推导了局部渐近功效结果。蒙特卡洛模拟揭示了该检验良好的大小和功效性质。重新审视十五篇进行工具变量回归的高被引论文，我们发现KPS在118个规范中的56个中在5%名义大小下未被拒绝。

articles.title_en: Factor-based imputation of missing values and covariances in panel data of large dimensions
articles.title_cn: 基于因子的高维面板数据缺失值与协方差插补
articles.abstract_en: Economists are blessed with a wealth of data for analysis, but more often than not, values in some entries of the data matrix are missing. Various methods have been proposed to handle missing observations in a few variables. We exploit the factor structure in panel data of large dimensions. Our tall-project algorithm first estimates the factors from a tall block in which data for all rows are observed, and projections of unit specific sample size are then used to estimate the factor loadings. A missing value is imputed by its estimated common component which we show is consistent and asymptotically normal without further iteration. Implications for using imputed data in factor augmented regressions are then discussed. To compensate for the downward bias in sample covariance matrices created by an omitted noise in each imputed value, we overlay the imputed data with re-sampled idiosyncratic residuals many times and use the average of the covariances to estimate the parameters of interest. Simulations show that the procedures have desirable finite sample properties.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济学家有幸拥有丰富的数据进行分析，但往往数据矩阵中某些条目的值是缺失的。针对少数变量中的缺失观测，已有多种方法被提出。我们利用大维度面板数据中的因子结构。我们的高块投影算法首先从所有行数据均被观测到的高块中估计因子，然后利用单位特定样本量的投影来估计因子载荷。缺失值通过其估计的共同成分进行插补，我们证明该插补值是一致的且渐近正态的，无需进一步迭代。随后讨论了在因子增强回归中使用插补数据的含义。为了弥补每个插补值中省略噪声导致的样本协方差矩阵向下偏差，我们多次将插补数据与重采样的特质残差叠加，并使用协方差的平均值来估计感兴趣参数。模拟表明，这些程序具有良好的有限样本性质。

articles.title_en: Group fused Lasso for large factor models with multiple structural breaks
articles.title_cn: 具有多重结构突变的大型因子模型的组融合Lasso方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper reformulates the identification of multiple structural breaks in factor loadings as a problem of detecting structural breaks in a factor regression, where the estimated pseudo factor corresponding to the largest eigenvalue is regressed on the remaining estimated factors. As a result, a group fused Lasso based estimation procedure is proposed to identify the break dates. Our procedure is practically easy-to-implement with standard statistical packages, overcoming the drawbacks of the existing methods that they often involve multiple tuning parameters and are computationally demanding in dealing with multiple unknown breaks. Theoretical properties of the proposed estimators are established, with a data driven choice of tuning parameter in the procedure. The Monte Carlo simulations and a real data application demonstrate that our procedure is fast implementable with desirable accuracy performance, and thus enjoys practical merits.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文将因子载荷中多重结构突变的识别问题重新表述为因子回归中结构突变的检测问题，其中对应于最大特征值的估计伪因子对剩余估计因子进行回归。因此，提出了一种基于组融合Lasso的估计程序来识别突变日期。我们的程序在标准统计软件包中易于实现，克服了现有方法通常涉及多个调谐参数且在处理多个未知突变时计算量大的缺点。所提出估计量的理论性质得以建立，并在程序中采用数据驱动的调谐参数选择。蒙特卡洛模拟和实际数据应用表明，我们的程序实现快速且具有理想的准确性表现，因此具有实际应用价值。

articles.title_cn: 含共同因子的高维向量自回归模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies high-dimensional vector autoregressions (VARs) augmented with common factors that allow for strong cross-sectional dependence. Models of this type provide a convenient mechanism for accommodating the interconnectedness and temporal co-variability that are often present in large dimensional systems. We propose an ℓ1-nuclear-norm regularized estimator and derive the non-asymptotic upper bounds for the estimation errors as well as large sample asymptotics for the estimates. A singular value thresholding procedure is used to determine the correct number of factors with probability approaching one. Both the LASSO estimator and the conservative LASSO estimator are employed to improve estimation precision. The conservative LASSO estimates of the non-zero coefficients are shown to be asymptotically equivalent to the oracle least squares estimates. Simulations demonstrate that our estimators perform reasonably well in finite samples given the complex high-dimensional nature of the model. In an empirical illustration we apply the methodology to explore dynamic connectedness in the volatilities of financial asset prices and the transmission of ‘investor fear’. The findings reveal that a large proportion of connectedness is due to the common factors. Conditional on the presence of these common factors, the results still document remarkable connectedness due to the interactions between the individual variables, thereby supporting a common factor augmented VAR specification.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究由允许强横截面依赖的共同因子增强的高维向量自回归（VAR）模型。此类模型为容纳大型维度系统中常见的互联性和时间协变性提供了便捷机制。我们提出了一种ℓ1-核范数正则化估计器，并推导了估计误差的非渐近上界以及估计量的大样本渐近性质。采用奇异值阈值化程序以概率趋近于一地确定因子的正确数量。同时使用LASSO估计器和保守LASSO估计器以提高估计精度。保守LASSO对非零系数的估计被证明与Oracle最小二乘估计渐近等价。模拟表明，鉴于模型复杂的高维性质，我们的估计器在有限样本中表现良好。在实证示例中，我们将该方法应用于探索金融资产价格波动率中的动态连通性以及‘投资者恐惧’的传导。研究结果显示，连通性的很大一部分归因于共同因子。在存在这些共同因子的条件下，结果仍记录了由于个体变量之间相互作用而产生的显著连通性，从而支持了共同因子增强的VAR设定。

articles.title_en: Treatment effects in interactive fixed effects models with a small number of time periods
articles.title_cn: 短时间周期交互固定效应模型中的处理效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper considers identifying and estimating the Average Treatment Effect on the Treated (ATT) when untreated potential outcomes are generated by an interactive fixed effects model. That is, in addition to time-period and individual fixed effects, we consider the case where there is an unobserved time invariant variable whose effect on untreated potential outcomes may change over time and which can therefore cause outcomes (in the absence of participating in the treatment) to follow different paths for the treated group relative to the untreated group. The models that we consider in this paper generalize many commonly used models in the treatment effects literature including difference in differences and individual-specific linear trend models. Unlike the majority of the literature on interactive fixed effects models, we do not require the number of time periods to go to infinity to consistently estimate the ATT. Our main identification result relies on having the effect of some time invariant covariate (e.g., race or sex) not vary over time. Using our approach, we show that the ATT can be identified with as few as three time periods and with panel or repeated cross sections data.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了当未处理潜在结果由交互固定效应模型生成时，识别和估计处理组平均处理效应（ATT）的问题。也就是说，除了时间周期和个体固定效应外，我们考虑存在一个未观测到的时不变变量，其对未处理潜在结果的影响可能随时间变化，因此可能导致处理组相对于未处理组的结果（在未参与处理的情况下）遵循不同的路径。本文考虑的模型推广了处理效应文献中许多常用模型，包括双重差分和个体特定线性趋势模型。与大多数关于交互固定效应模型的文献不同，我们不需要时间周期数趋于无穷大即可一致估计ATT。我们的主要识别结果依赖于某些时不变协变量（如种族或性别）的影响不随时间变化。使用我们的方法，我们表明ATT可以在至少三个时间周期以及面板或重复横截面数据下被识别。

articles.title_en: Quasi-maximum likelihood estimation of break point in high-dimensional factor models
articles.title_cn: 高维因子模型中断点的拟极大似然估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a quasi-maximum likelihood (QML) estimator of the break point for large-dimensional factor models with a single structural break in the factor loading matrix. We show that the QML estimator is consistent for the true break point when the covariance matrix of the pre- or post-break factor loading (or both) is singular. Consistency here means that the deviation of the estimated break date from the true break date k0 converges to zero as the sample size grows. This is a much stronger result than the break fraction kˆ/T being T-consistent (super-consistent) for k0/T. Also, singularity occurs for most types of structural changes, except for a rotational change. Even for a rotational change, the QML estimator is still T-consistent in terms of the break fraction. Simulation results confirm the theoretical properties of our estimator, and it significantly outperforms existing estimators for change points in factor models.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文针对因子载荷矩阵存在单一结构断点的大维因子模型，提出了一种断点的拟极大似然（QML）估计量。我们证明，当断点前或断点后因子载荷（或两者）的协方差矩阵奇异时，QML估计量对于真实断点是一致的。这里的一致性意味着，随着样本量的增长，估计断点日期与真实断点日期k0的偏差收敛到零。这比断点分数kˆ/T对于k0/T具有T一致性（超一致性）的结果要强得多。此外，除旋转变化外，大多数类型的结构变化都会出现奇异性。即使对于旋转变化，QML估计量在断点分数方面仍然具有T一致性。模拟结果证实了我们估计量的理论性质，并且它显著优于现有的因子模型变点估计量。

articles.title_en: Information criteria for latent factor models: A study on factor pervasiveness and adaptivity
articles.title_cn: 潜在因子模型的信息准则：因子普遍性与适应性的研究
articles.abstract_en: We study the information criteria extensively under general conditions for high-dimensional latent factor models. Upon carefully analyzing the estimation errors of the principal component analysis method, we establish theoretical results on the estimation accuracy of the latent factor scores, incorporating the impact from possibly weak factor pervasiveness; our analysis does not require the same factor strength of all the leading factors. To estimate the number of the latent factors, we propose a new penalty specification with a two-fold consideration: i) being adaptive to the strength of the factor pervasiveness, and ii) favoring more parsimonious models. Our theory establishes the validity of the proposed approach under general conditions. Additionally, we construct examples to demonstrate that when the factor strength is too weak, scenarios exist such that no information criterion can consistently identify the latent factors. We illustrate the performance of the proposed adaptive information criteria with extensive numerical examples, including simulations and a real data analysis.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在高维潜在因子模型的一般条件下广泛研究了信息准则。通过仔细分析主成分分析方法的估计误差，我们建立了潜在因子得分估计精度的理论结果，并纳入了可能较弱的因子普遍性的影响；我们的分析不要求所有主要因子具有相同的因子强度。为了估计潜在因子的数量，我们提出了一种新的惩罚规范，具有双重考虑：i) 适应因子普遍性的强度，ii) 倾向于更简约的模型。我们的理论在一般条件下确立了所提出方法的有效性。此外，我们构造了例子来证明当因子强度过弱时，存在没有任何信息准则能够一致识别潜在因子的情况。我们通过广泛的数值例子（包括模拟和真实数据分析）展示了所提出的自适应信息准则的性能。

articles.title_en: Identifying latent factors based on high-frequency data
articles.title_cn: 基于高频数据识别潜在因子
articles.abstract_en: This paper tests whether the continuous component of an observable candidate factor is in the space spanned by the counterparts of latent common factors with high-frequency financial data. We introduce two identification strategies corresponding to two types of regressions: the regressions of intraday asset returns on the estimated factors and the candidate, and the regression of the candidate factor on the estimated ones. We construct the test statistics by adding randomness to the statistics obtained from residuals of the regressions, and demonstrate the consistency of the novel randomized tests. Simulations are conducted to evaluate the performance of the tests in finite samples. We also perform empirical applications to identify the relationships between some candidate factors and the latent ones, and further use the factors selected by the tests for portfolio allocation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文检验了可观测候选因子的连续成分是否位于由潜在共同因子的对应成分所张成的空间中，使用的是高频金融数据。我们引入了两种识别策略，对应于两类回归：日内资产收益率对估计因子和候选因子的回归，以及候选因子对估计因子的回归。我们通过向回归残差所得的统计量中添加随机性来构造检验统计量，并证明了新颖的随机化检验的一致性。我们进行了模拟以评估检验在有限样本中的表现。我们还进行了实证应用，以识别某些候选因子与潜在因子之间的关系，并进一步使用检验选出的因子进行投资组合配置。

articles.title_en: Large dimensional latent factor modeling with missing observations and applications to causal inference
articles.title_cn: 大规模维度潜因子建模中的缺失观测及其在因果推断中的应用
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops the inferential theory for latent factor models estimated from large dimensional panel data with missing observations. We propose an easy-to-use all-purpose estimator for a latent factor model by applying principal component analysis to an adjusted covariance matrix estimated from partially observed panel data. We derive the asymptotic distribution for the estimated factors, loadings and the imputed values under an approximate factor model and general missing patterns. The key application is to estimate counterfactual outcomes in causal inference from panel data. The unobserved control group is modeled as missing values, which are inferred from the latent factor model. The inferential theory for the imputed values allows us to test for individual treatment effects at any time under general adoption patterns where the units can be affected by unobserved factors.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文发展了从具有缺失观测的大规模面板数据中估计潜因子模型的推断理论。我们提出了一种易于使用的通用潜因子模型估计方法，通过对部分观测面板数据估计的调整协方差矩阵进行主成分分析。在近似因子模型和一般缺失模式下，我们推导了估计因子、载荷和插补值的渐近分布。关键应用是从面板数据中估计因果推断的反事实结果。未观测的控制组被建模为缺失值，这些缺失值从潜因子模型中推断出来。插补值的推断理论使我们能够在一般采纳模式下，在任意时间点检验个体处理效应，其中个体可能受到未观测因素的影响。

articles.title_en: Testing for structural changes in large dimensional factor models via discrete Fourier transform
articles.title_cn: 基于离散傅里叶变换的大维因子模型结构变化检验
articles.abstract_en: We propose a new test for structural changes in large dimensional factor models using a discrete Fourier transform (DFT) approach. When structural changes occur, the conventional principal component analysis may fail to estimate the common factors and factor loadings consistently, and the estimated residuals contain information about the structural changes. This allows us to compare the DFT of the estimated residuals weighted by the estimated common factors with the null (zero) spectrum implied by no structural change. The proposed test is powerful against both smooth structural changes and abrupt structural breaks with an unknown number of breaks and unknown break dates in factor loadings. It can detect a class of local alternatives at the rate N−1/2T−1/2, where N and T are the numbers of cross-sectional units and time periods, respectively. Monte Carlo studies demonstrate that the proposed test has reasonable size and excellent power in detecting various structural changes in factor loadings. When applied to the U.S. macroeconomic data, the test reveals significant and robust evidence of time-varying factor loadings for the post-Great Moderation sample and the pre-Great Recession subsample, which the existing literature may fail to address.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种利用离散傅里叶变换（DFT）方法检验大维因子模型中结构变化的新检验。当结构变化发生时，传统的主成分分析可能无法一致地估计公共因子和因子载荷，估计残差中包含结构变化的信息。这使得我们可以将估计残差（由估计的公共因子加权）的DFT与无结构变化所隐含的零谱进行比较。所提出的检验对平滑结构变化和突变结构断裂均具有功效，且无需知道断裂次数和因子载荷中的断裂日期。它可以检测一类局部备择假设，其速率为N−1/2T−1/2，其中N和T分别为截面单位数和时间期数。蒙特卡洛研究表明，所提出的检验在检测因子载荷的各种结构变化方面具有合理的水平和优异的功效。当应用于美国宏观经济数据时，该检验揭示了大稳健时期之后样本和大衰退之前子样本中因子载荷时变性的显著且稳健的证据，而现有文献可能未能解决这一问题。
